mapper.insert: insert into ai_creation_plan (author_id, book_id, stage, creative_params, plan_content, outline_version, create_time, update_time) values (#{authorId}, #{bookId}, #{stage}, #{creativeParams}, #{planContent}, #{outlineVersion}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, author_id, book_id, stage, creative_params, plan_content, outline_version, create_time, update_time from ai_creation_plan where author_id = #{authorId} and book_id is null order by id desc limit 1
